name: User uploads audio and receives speech analysis metrics

planSteps.description: Open http://localhost:3000/ and verify the SpeechLens analysis interface is visible
Select the 'Synthetic: Rushed Delivery (Severity 4)' preset from the dropdown and click 'Load Preset'
Verify that scoreOverall displays '79.4' and scorePace displays '65.7'
Verify that the time-series canvas and grounded flaw region cards are displayed
